about: USGS's Water Data API (api.waterdata.usgs.gov/ogcapi/v1, OGC API, GeoJSON, no key): latest-continuous gives each time series' newest reading, every 5 to 60 minutes as the gauge reports; here New York's discharge (00060) and gage height (00065), about 800 series in one page (the API gives up to 50,000). Times are in UTC (+00:00); the day is the device's, which is New York's for the person. A discontinued series keeps its last reading, years old, marked DISCONTINUED.
